headline: Failed House resolution would have found Attorney General Merrick Garland in contempt of the House for not obeying a subpoena.
what_it_does: This resolution would have declared that Attorney General Merrick Garland was in contempt of the House of Representatives for disobeying a subpoena. The title does not say which subpoena, and no official summary is available. It also does not say what penalties, if any, would have followed. The House voted it down on July 11, 2024.

who_it_affects.how: He would have been formally found in contempt of the House for not obeying a House subpoena.
